text:
sophie: quick sync  opened a docs PR to clarify pricing tier attribution across orgs and add a small CSV export example + dashboard alert. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5582

matt: nice. can you show the new `billing_scope` field usage? that's causing confusion with multi-org customers. also add an example CSV export line so customers can reconcile invoices to dashboard numbers.

clara: +1 on the CSV. ops teams often want a one-line reconciliation example they can drop into a spreadsheet. also recommend a Grafana alert snippet for unexpected tier shifts (helps catch onboarding bugs).

sophie: draft snippets below, kept compact. using ISO timestamps and explicit `Authorization` header per style guide.

```bash
# curl: query usage with billing_scope to get per-billing-account tier breakdown
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-02-28T23:59:59Z","breakdown":"tier","filters":{"product":"embeddings"},"billing_scope":"billing_account:bill_abc"}'
```

```csv
# CSV export example (one-row per tier) - header + sample row
"billing_account","tier","tokens","month","unit_price_usd"
"bill_abc","startup","123456","2026-02","0.0004"
```

```text
# short reconciliation tip to add under the CSV example
Note: Reserved capacity credits are consumed before on-demand credits. When reconciling, subtract reserved-token usage (reserved_* columns in export) before multiplying unit prices. Tier labels are resolved by billing_scope; accounts sharing billing will show the same tier.
```

ops-analytics: grafana alert suggestion (minimal):

`Alert: title="Tier switch anomaly" expr="changes(max_over_time(redwood_account_tier{billing_account=\"bill_abc\"}[7d])) > 0" for="1h" labels={severity="warning"}`

matt: nit: escape double quotes in the inline expr or keep as a code block; code block is fine. Also add a short sentence in the FAQ: "What is billing_scope?" Answer: "A stable identifier used to resolve pricing tiers; use billing_scope in API queries to get consistent tiered views for shared accounts."

sophie: added FAQ bullet and a sample one-line response shape for the usage query so readers know what keys to expect: '[{"tier":"startup","tokens":123456,"billing_account":"bill_abc"}]'. Also clarified that system/ephemeral tokens are filtered from public exports.

billing-eng: confirm phrasing about reserved-first consumption and per-second prorating. Quick confirm: "Reserved credits consumed first; tier credits prorated per-second; invoice rounding occurs at billing run." I'll add a one-line comment to the PR copy for accuracy.

docs-bot: PR updated: sophie pushed 2 commits to docs/pricing-billing_scope-csv at 6187654400  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5582/files

sam-qa: smoke done in staging: curl returns 200 and sample shape matches, CSV sample generated via export tool, grafana alert validates in staging grafana. no unexpected diffs.

matt: LGTM. I'll approve after CI. thanks for the clear reconciliation example, should reduce billing tickets.

sophie: thanks everyone :rocket:
